 Match Preview
 Liga MX - Game Week 16 7 Nov 2026 - 18:00 Estadio Universitario/El Volcan Tigres host Cruz Azul at Estadio Universitario in San Nicolas de los Garza in a Liga MX Apertura fixture that carries real weight at both ends of the table.
 Guido Pizarro's side sit 15th in the Apertura standings and are in desperate need of a result at El Volcan. Their recent form has been poor, and a home win is far from guaranteed against a Cruz Azul outfit that has been one of the form teams in the division.
 Cruz Azul arrive under Joel Huiqui having won four of their last five Liga MX matches. They crushed FC Juarez 5-0, won at Pachuca, and most recently beat Leon 2-1 to cement their place in third.
 Tigres, by contrast, have managed just one win in their last five. Back-to-back draws against Club Universidad Nacional and CD Guadalajara were followed by a 3-0 defeat to Pachuca in their most recent outing.
 The gap in current form is stark. Cruz Azul will travel to Nuevo Leon with genuine confidence, while Tigres must find a way to halt a slide that has left them deep in the bottom half.
